title: 第385章 二女脱胎换骨
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

九十丈！

八十丈！

五十丈！！

当达到五十丈距离时，二女身上压力陡增。

体内血脉之力自主激发，自动护主，艰难对抗着九尾天狐的血脉威压！

肩头上，仿佛扛着两尊万古神山，每一步都迈得艰难无比……

“这才五十丈，居然就已经这么难了。”小灵儿咬牙。

她费劲迈步，每踏出一步，都会耗去不少体力。

“香香姐姐，我快要走不动了！”

“这雕像，该不会是狐族历史上仅有的那位九尾天狐老祖吧？”

小灵儿的额头上香汗淋漓。

香香也感受到了不小压力，“应该是，别分神，现出本体！”

“好！”

一道粉白色狐影，出现在雕像脚下。

小灵儿身上的压力顿时减轻了不少。

四十丈！

三十丈！！

在达到此处之时，周遭威压又上升了一个大台阶。

小灵儿华丽的狐躯，在血脉威压下渐渐开始颤抖，已然达到了血脉极限……

“不够，还不够。”

“我要继续走！！”

哗啦啦。

粉白色狐影背后，六条粉白色狐尾摇曳而出。

小灵儿继续向前，可没等踏入二十丈范围，她的本体又无法继续动弹了。

小灵儿咬牙，灵眸中涌现出浓浓不甘心。

她不要只当附庸侍妾。

她要变强，她要帮助云江仙，她要在她身边永远的占据一席之地！

强烈执念下，体内血脉如开水般沸腾。

灵光狐族血脉深处，一缕缕远古之力正在激发复苏，快速改变她的体质，升华着她的血脉之力。

嗡！！！

第七道狐尾，在其背后浮现而出。

她身上压力大减，足下快速动作，短短数息便踏入二十丈区域内！

到了此处，空气中仿佛多了一堵无形之墙，挡住了她的去路。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ninety feet!

Eighty feet!

Fifty feet!!

When they reached a distance of fifty feet, the pressure on the two women increased sharply.

The power of the blood within the body is activated independently, automatically protecting the master, and struggling to resist the pressure of the nine-tailed sky fox's blood!

On his shoulders, he seemed to be carrying two eternal sacred mountains, and every step he took was extremely difficult...

"It's only fifty feet, but it's already so difficult." Xiao Ling'er gritted her teeth.

She took steps with great effort, and every step she took would consume a lot of energy.

"Sister Xiangxiang, I can't walk anymore!"

"Could this statue be the only nine-tailed sky fox ancestor in the history of the fox clan?"

Xiao Ling'er's forehead was dripping with sweat.

Xiangxiang also felt a lot of pressure, "It should be, don't be distracted, show your true body!"

"Okay!"

A pink and white fox shadow appeared at the foot of the statue.

The pressure on Xiao Ling'er suddenly eased a lot.

Forty feet!

Thirty feet!!

When they reached this point, the pressure around them rose to another level.

Xiao Ling'er's gorgeous fox body gradually began to tremble under the pressure of the bloodline, and it had reached the limit of the bloodline...

"Not enough, not enough."

"I want to keep walking!!"

Crash.

Behind the pink and white fox shadow, six pink and white fox tails swayed out.

Little Ling'er continued to move forward, but before she could reach the twenty-foot range, her body could no longer move.

Little Ling'er gritted her teeth, with deep reluctance in her eyes.

She doesn't want to be just a vassal and concubine.

She wants to become stronger, she wants to help Yunjiangxian, and she wants to occupy a place by her side forever!

Under the strong obsession, the blood in the body boils like boiling water.

Deep in the bloodline of the Lingguang Fox Clan, wisps of ancient power are stimulating recovery, rapidly changing her physique and sublimating the power of her bloodline.

Buzz!!!

The seventh fox tail emerged from behind it.

The pressure on her body was greatly reduced, and with quick movements, she stepped into the twenty-foot area in just a few breaths!

Once here, there seemed to be an invisible wall in the air, blocking her way.
